changes.title: Circle baby sigil
items: With the runestone spell on (?cast=1), a legend circle's baby's sigil now lands in its circle when its soundsystem comes, fading out of the stack and in where it lands

changes.title: Dealt along route
items: An island's own creature is always the first area the waves reach, and the same creature never comes two waves in a row
Each night on an island deals its creatures' areas afresh along that night's route; the island's shape stays the same

changes.title: Runestone spell on
items: The runestone stacks and the soundsystem spell are on: hold the sigil button at a stone to turn its area
The spell's ring of bars round the stone dances to the music
Leash chains swing and hang with real weight, from each creature's sigil in your stack
Sigils scattered by a conversion fall from the stone's column to the ground, and glint until picked up
A sleeping legend's sigil sits at the bottom of your stack, its chain running back to the legend
